workItems.objective: Checkpoint immutable integration plans and effects and recover uncertain outcomes without duplicate mutation.

included: Persist prepared plan and raw adapter observations with one idempotency identity.
Reconcile crash-before-effect, crash-after-effect-before-checkpoint, interruption, retry, and exact replay from repository observations.
excluded: Blindly rerunning an uncertain effect or overwriting prior attempts.

deliverables.description: Integration checkpoint controller and uncertain-effect recovery protocol.

dependency-hints.rationale: Checkpoint identity binds the exact IntegrationPlan.
Recovery validates native adapter effect observations.

checks.method: Exercise success, failure, interruption, retry, exact replay, changed-input, duplicate identity, and crash-after-effect reconciliation fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Every effect remains immutable and exact replay performs zero Git mutation calls without duplicating the target transition.

required-evidence.description: Every effect remains immutable and exact replay performs zero Git mutation calls without duplicating the target transition.

workItems.objective: Define the closed provider-neutral ChangeIntegration artifacts, module surface, and integration adapter port.

included: Define exact subject, plan, raw effect, conflict, outcome, post-state, checkpoint, and traceability artifacts.
Forbid adapter-owned verification approval, scope mutation, automatic conflict resolution, graph mutation, SystemVerification, and BusinessAcceptance.
excluded: Performing a repository mutation or accepting adapter prose as integration proof.

deliverables.description: Versioned ChangeIntegration module definition and integration port.

checks.method: Compile every schema and exercise positive, negative, unknown-field, forbidden-authority, and adapter-substitution fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Only closed provider-neutral ChangeIntegration artifacts validate and the adapter port exposes no upstream or downstream authority.

required-evidence.description: Only closed provider-neutral ChangeIntegration artifacts validate and the adapter port exposes no upstream or downstream authority.

workItems.objective: Document ChangeIntegration inputs, plans, compare-and-swap, local Git adapter, conflicts, recovery, outcomes, traceability, and extension points.

included: Explain exact verified-subject binding, atomic local target effects, no-auto-resolution, uncertain-effect recovery, and downstream SystemVerification.
Provide operator examples for success, conflict, drift, failure, retry, resume, and future remote adapters.
excluded: Claiming automatic conflict resolution, remote PR support, deployment, SystemVerification, or BusinessAcceptance in V1.

deliverables.description: ChangeIntegration operator, adapter, and IDE documentation.

dependency-hints.rationale: Documentation must cite final verified behavior and exact integration evidence.

checks.method: Review documentation against approved requirements, architecture, contracts, release evidence, and actual integration handoffs.
checks.successCriteria: Operators can run and audit ChangeIntegration without confusing integration with verification, system validation, deployment, or business acceptance.

required-evidence.description: Operators can run and audit ChangeIntegration without confusing integration with verification, system validation, deployment, or business acceptance.

workItems.objective: Bind one exact Gate-approved verified change and deterministically build its immutable integration plan.

included: Validate WorkItemVerificationGate approval, verified bytes, target snapshot, ref, expected commit, policy, baselines, adapter, and grants.
Bind the only authorized target transition and idempotency identity.
excluded: Observing or mutating the live target ref, invoking Git, or deciding success.

deliverables.description: Integration input guard and deterministic plan builder.

dependency-hints.rationale: Input and plan artifacts must conform to canonical contracts.

checks.method: Exercise exact, missing, duplicate, substituted, stale, reordered, wrong-target, wrong-policy, and over-granted fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Core produces one byte-stable IntegrationPlan bound to the exact approved subject and only authorized target transition.

required-evidence.description: Core produces one byte-stable IntegrationPlan bound to the exact approved subject and only authorized target transition.

workItems.objective: Implement the V1 bounded local Git integration adapter behind the provider-neutral port.

included: Apply only the exact verified change under the authorized IntegrationPlan.
Return exact native pre-state, operation, conflict or failure, post-state, and raw evidence.
excluded: Selecting targets, altering verified bytes, automatically resolving conflicts, approving integration, or authoring graph operations.

deliverables.description: Local Git integration adapter and conformance fixtures.

dependency-hints.rationale: The adapter must implement the canonical integration port.
The adapter may run only after exact target authorization.

checks.method: Run clean, conflict, malformed, denied, interrupted, wrong-target, changed-byte, and substituted-adapter fixtures against isolated Git repositories.
checks.successCriteria: The adapter performs only one authorized conditional local Git effect and never resolves conflicts or claims lifecycle authority.

required-evidence.description: The adapter performs only one authorized conditional local Git effect and never resolves conflicts or claims lifecycle authority.

workItems.objective: Validate native integration effects into one closed canonical outcome and exact post-state evidence.

included: Prove target parentage, tree, ref, verified change identity, raw evidence, and no-mutation failures.
Return IntegratedChangeRecord plus updated RepositorySnapshot, IntegrationConflictSet, baseline-drift, unable-to-proceed, or execution-failed.
excluded: Inferring success from exit code or prose, resolving conflicts, or claiming SystemVerification or BusinessAcceptance.

deliverables.description: Integration result validator and closed outcome assembler.

dependency-hints.rationale: Result validation consumes only replay-verified native effect evidence.
Success and no-mutation outcomes are checked against the authorized target transition.

checks.method: Exercise valid, wrong-parent, wrong-tree, wrong-ref, substituted-change, forged-success, no-mutation conflict, drift, unknown-outcome, and downstream-claim fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Only exact evidenced repository incorporation yields IntegratedChangeRecord; every other state is explicit and cannot unlock completion.

required-evidence.description: Only exact evidenced repository incorporation yields IntegratedChangeRecord; every other state is explicit and cannot unlock completion.

workItems.objective: Authorize integration only through an exact target-ref compare-and-swap boundary.

included: Compare the live configured ref to the expected commit immediately before effect authorization.
Require a host-atomic conditional ref transition and serialize concurrent verified changes.
excluded: Rebasing stale work, choosing another target, or resolving conflicts.

deliverables.description: Target-ref compare-and-swap coordinator and concurrency fixtures.

dependency-hints.rationale: Compare-and-swap authority consumes one exact immutable IntegrationPlan.

checks.method: Exercise exact, stale, rewritten, missing, deleted, and concurrently advanced refs and prove only one conditional update can proceed.
checks.successCriteria: Only an exact expected target commit receives one bounded effect authorization; every mismatch yields no mutation.

required-evidence.description: Only an exact expected target commit receives one bounded effect authorization; every mismatch yields no mutation.

workItems.objective: Derive forward-only factual integrated-change relationships through a trusted contributor.

included: Link WorkItem and ChangeSet to IntegratedChangeRecord after validated success.
Link affected architecture and contracts to the resulting change with atomic merge proof.
excluded: Adapter-authored graph operations, inverse edges, premature integration facts, acceptance-criterion verified-by facts, SystemVerification, or BusinessAcceptance.

deliverables.description: Integrated-change traceability contributor and merge proof.

dependency-hints.rationale: Factual edges derive only from one validated IntegratedChangeRecord.

checks.method: Derive, validate, atomically merge, replay, and query allowed forward edges while rejecting arbitrary, inverse, premature, verification, system, and business edges.
checks.successCriteria: Integrated-change lineage is reproducible and factual edges exist only after exact validated integration success.

required-evidence.description: Integrated-change lineage is reproducible and factual edges exist only after exact validated integration success.

workItems.objective: Release-gate ChangeIntegration across contracts, input binding, compare-and-swap, adapter effects, recovery, outcomes, traceability, and packaging.

included: Run focused and package-level regression, drift, conflict, atomicity, replay, authority, substitution, and recovery checks.
Dogfood the first Gate-approved WorkExecution change through WorkItemVerification and local Git integration.
excluded: Treating repository integration as SystemVerification or BusinessAcceptance, or claiming fixture conformance as live remote-provider conformance.

deliverables.description: ChangeIntegration release verification evidence and first factual integration proof.

dependency-hints.rationale: The real bounded integration effect must be testable.
Replay and uncertain-effect behavior must be complete.
Closed canonical outcomes must be complete.
Factual post-integration traceability must be complete.

checks.method: Run the canonical package gate, isolated Git mutation tests, conflict and drift tests, crash recovery, zero-call replay, adapter substitution, and the first verified-item integration.
checks.successCriteria: All ChangeIntegration gates pass deterministically, one exact verified item is factually integrated, and SystemVerification remains downstream.

required-evidence.description: All ChangeIntegration gates pass deterministically, one exact verified item is factually integrated, and SystemVerification remains downstream.
